name: pp-pr-review
description: Gated, sub-agent-driven PR review for Azure DevOps. Verifies the repo, redacts PII, fans out parallel analyses (core logic, tests, security, SQL/JPA, memory, performance, and POLYPOINT Coding Guidelines), triages findings with the developer into a curated set, runs a cross-cutting pass, then drafts and posts PR comments only on explicit confirmation.
